Beginning at a point in the Southeasterly line of Kings Highway West, distant 80.00 feet Southwesterly from the intersection of the southeasterly line of Kings Highway West with the Northwesterly line of Chews Landing Road, said point being corner to land of the Borough of Haddonfield; thence

1) South 54 degrees 22 minutes 25 seconds West along the Southeasterly line of Kings West, 300.55 feet to a point; thence

2) South 25 degrees 37 minutes 35 seconds East at right angles to Kings Highway West 120.68 feet to corner to other land of John J. Litz and Caroline, his wife; thence

3) South 68 degrees 39 minutes 05 seconds East along said land of Litz, at right angles to Chews Landing Road 171.43 feet to a point in the Northwesterly line of said Chews Landing Road; thence

4) North 21 degrees 20 minutes 55 seconds East along the Northwesterly line of Chews Landing Road 280.55 feet to corner to said land of the Borough of Haddonfield; thence

5) North 47 degrees 08 minutes 20 seconds West along said land of the Borough of Haddonfield, 58.67 feet to the point and place of beginning.
